itinerary.summary: A 4-day, moderate-paced cultural trip to Jaipur, India, built around History, Food, Shopping on a moderate budget. Rajasthan's Pink City: palaces, hilltop forts, bazaars and traditional crafts in a compact, easy-to-explore city.
